crossRefs.note: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.

people.name: Ebed
people.line: Father of Gaal, who opposed Abimelech's rule

people.name: Gaal
people.line: Son of Ebed; led a revolt against Abimelech.

translations.web: When Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger burned.
translations.bsb: When Zebul the governor of the city heard the words of Gaal son of Ebed, he burned with anger.
translations.kjv: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
translations.asv: And when Zebul the ruler of the city heard the words of Gaal the son of Ebed, his anger was kindled.
